sentence_stem: Although the report was widely shared online,
full_sentence: Although the report was widely shared online, few readers checked its sources.
acceptable_variants: many people still believed its claims.
the corrections spread more slowly than the original story.

options.text: so the editors removed it from the website.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, not a result. Use 'so' only to show a consequence of the first clause.

options.text: the headline was printed in bold letters.
options.why_wrong: This describes the layout but does not contrast with the idea of the report being widely shared.

options.text: it was written by a local student.
options.why_wrong: This adds a detail about the author but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the second clause must show contrast with the first part of the sentence. A clause that gives a result or adds only a neutral detail breaks this logic.
translation: Rapor geniş çapta internette paylaşılmasına rağmen, az sayıda okuyucu kaynaklarını kontrol etti.
